title: Tone clue: wistful
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits the sentence.

parts.prompt: Rafi gave a wistful smile as he looked at the empty football field where his old team had once practised. What does “wistful” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: Remembering a valued past place with a subdued smile suggests quiet longing.
choice_rationales.B: There is no sign of anger.
choice_rationales.C: Rafi knows what happened at the field.
choice_rationales.D: The memory is tender and regretful rather than comic.

parts.hint: Combine the remembered place with the kind of smile described.
parts.correct_explanation: The memory of a past team and the subdued smile create a tone of quiet longing.
